pattern: Native form with labelled AbsoluteUI controls (each follows its own APG pattern), Fieldset groups for objects and arrays, and the GOV.UK-style Error Summary from Form.

roles.role: form (native, named by label or the schema title)

aria.value: help text and messages (from the controls and Fieldset)

keyboard.action: Move through fields, entry actions, the add button, and the submit button.
Act; focus stays on the moved entry's action or moves to the next entry.

focus: After a failed submission focus moves to the Error Summary (or the first field, per Form's focusOnInvalid). Adding an entry focuses its first field; removing focuses the next entry's remove button or the add button.
notes: Array changes are announced through the polite live region (added, removed, moved to position N of M).
Conditional fields are removed from the accessibility tree while hidden and never block submission.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
